name: Lucis public API
description:
Lucis is a preventive wellness membership (lucis.life).

This specification describes the public biomarker catalog, OAuth 2.0 discovery/token endpoints, and RFC RateLimit headers hosted on www.lucis.life.

Unauthenticated GET is supported on the catalog. An optional client_credentials access token with scope `catalog.read` is available; it is not required.

Public endpoints advertise RateLimit and RateLimit-Policy on every response, and Retry-After on HTTP 429. Quota is best-effort per compute instance. A shared store is not required for the public catalog.

This API never returns individual member results or other health data. Lucis.life does not currently publish outbound member webhooks or an MCP server.
